Initial release: Comprehensive Rust best practices reference skill

- Covers idiomatic and production-grade Rust engineering across ownership, error handling, API design, concurrency/async, performance, unsafe Rust, testing, tooling, web/CLI frameworks, project structure, and supply-chain security.
- Includes indexed reference chapters with task-to-file mapping, in-depth explanations, code examples, anti-pattern checklists, and links to authoritative Rust resources.
